name: session-warning-dialog
purpose: Alert dialog (built on Dialog) that counts down to a session deadline (an Instant) and offers "Stay signed in" and "Sign out" (WCAG 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable). Remaining time is a duration from the deadline to the current clock, so it is timezone independent. Announcements are throttled to thresholds. It pauses, extends, and ends nothing on its own: it emits aui-extend, aui-sign-out, and aui-expire.
whenToUse: Warning users before an inactivity or absolute session timeout.
Any deadline where the user must be able to extend with one simple action.
whenNotToUse: Non-urgent notices: use Toast or Alert.
Enforcing the timeout: the server owns session expiry.
states: suspended (answered; waits for a new expiresAt)
responsive: Uses Dialog size sm; buttons wrap on narrow screens.
rtl: Follows Dialog: logical properties; the countdown text follows the locale.
theme: Dialog surface and Button variants; the countdown uses color-text with tabular numbers. No animation of its own; Dialog transitions follow reduced motion.
timezone: Timezone independent: expiresAt is an Instant and remaining time is expiresAt minus Date.now(). Only the device clock matters; compare the deadline with your server's expiry to limit clock skew.
security: The component never signs anyone out, extends a session, or stores tokens: it emits events for the application to act on. All text is rendered with textContent. AbsoluteUI is not an authentication provider. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: Holds only the deadline and texts in memory. No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: One dialog per page; one timer at a time.

limitations: Background tabs throttle timers; the countdown is recomputed from the clock on the next tick, so it is correct but can update late.
A deadline in the past at creation opens in the expired state without emitting aui-expire.
After the user answers, auto-open is suspended until update({ expiresAt }).
Escape extends the session by default (escapeExtends).
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
unsupported: Activity tracking (pointer or key activity): the application decides when the session was used.
Cross-tab coordination (use BroadcastChannel in the application and call update()).
antiPatterns: Signing the user out without warning or less than 20 seconds to respond.
Extending the session on the client only.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/session-warning-dialog: AuiSessionWarningDialog directive (ng-template[auiSessionWarningDialog], hand-written); the template content is added below the countdown.
